lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial region, with the second and third rows from the top displaying the largest diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Series of vertical pale bands of elevated intensity intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like grid; spots are primarily centered within the rectangular regions formed by these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges running parallel to the dorsal midline, characterized by a high-contrast light-to-shadow gradient defining the lateral topology.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Dense distribution of small high-luminance spots across the first dorsal fin silhouette, with spatial frequency increasing toward the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density field of micro-spots (low-radius high-luminance clusters) concentrated on the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
